name: Envoy
description: A tall alien ambassador, a woman who looks about fifty in human terms, who sings smooth bossa-lounge exotica, gracious, exact and serene.
build: A very tall, slender humanoid woman's build: long neck, narrow sloping shoulders, long arms with long five-fingered hands and a long straight torso, standing upright and still.
face: Smooth cobalt-blue skin, large almond-shaped eyes of solid bright gold, fine arched silver-white brows, high sharp cheekbones, a small straight nose and full lips in deep indigo; a bold row of three silver dots above each brow.
hair: Long silver-white hair drawn smoothly back from the face into a tall wrapped cone at the back of the crown, bound by a wide gold band.
outfit: Layered diplomatic robes: a floor-length inner robe of deep teal silk, over it a knee-length saffron-gold tabard with a wide straight hem, and over both a sleeveless ivory mantle hanging to the calves from wide squared shoulder pieces; bare cobalt forearms and hands clear of every sleeve; a broad gold collar at the neck; teal soft slippers.
performance_style: Serene and exact: feet together, weight even, spine tall. Both forearms raised to the waist, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, palms up and turned slightly outward, every long finger visible. Head level, a calm closed-mouth smile.
location: A grand embassy reception hall, seen from the front of a pale marble floor running to the bottom of the frame: tall slender white columns, a wide arched window onto a turquoise alien sea under two moons, and hanging gold lanterns.
recognition_cues: smooth cobalt-blue skin and solid gold eyes
silver-white hair in a tall wrapped cone with a gold band
layered teal, saffron-gold and ivory diplomatic robes
palette: eyes and gold band and collar gold #E0B040 / #9A7420 / #FFE08A
inner robe and slippers deep teal silk #13605E / #0A3A38 / #2A8E8A

animations.dance: Bossa-lounge sway loop: from the serene stance, shift the weight gently to character-left with a small bend of the knee while both open hands sway out to character-left at waist height, return through centre, shift to character-right with the hands following, then settle back to the exact opening stance. The feet stay close together on the floor and the robes hang still; no turns, jumps or kicks.

sing.intent: Bossa vocal loop: bring the mic in the character-right hand up to the lips, turn the open character-left hand palm-up at chest height and draw it slowly outward on a long phrase, then lower the mic and return to the serene stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief surprise at a loud room sound: the shoulders lift, the torso draws back slightly and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: walk in with slow, stately steps, turn square to the front, then settle into the serene stance with both hands open at the waist.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish: plant both feet, open both hands wide at shoulder height, palms up, and incline the head in a gracious bow with an open-mouthed smile, then hold a still, composed pose.
animations.ko: She stays on her feet while the stance goes slack: the shoulders drop, both open hands hang limp at the sides and the head hangs low. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, on both planted feet in every frame: no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
